description: A choice among options too many to show at once, or not all seen together (DESIGN.md, Select). The trigger looks like a text field with a chevron and the selected label (or placeholder); Enter, Space or an arrow key opens a listbox panel (menu panel styling) anchored under it, the selected option ticked and scrolled into view. Type-ahead, groups and separators come from the listbox; Escape closes it. Below TsuyaBreakpoint.tablet the options open in a Sheet titled by label instead, unless sheetOnPhone is false.

constructors.description: A select named label, value chosen among options.

params.name: label
params.description: The accessible name, shown above the trigger.

params.name: value
params.description: The chosen value, or null when nothing is chosen yet.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with an option's value when it is chosen; null disables the control.

params.name: options
params.description: The options, in order; options sharing a ListboxOption.group should be adjacent.

params.name: placeholder
params.description: Shown in TsuyaColors.textMuted while nothing is chosen; never announced (a placeholder is not a value).

params.name: sheetOnPhone
params.description: Below the tablet width, the options open in a sheet rather than a panel.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track the trigger's focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses the trigger as soon as it is built.
